title: Saffron City & Silph Co.
subtitle: Fighting Dojo, eleven floors of Rockets, Lapras, Master Ball, Marsh Badge

steps.text: Give Tea to a gate guard to enter Saffron. Team Rocket occupies Silph Co.; the gym and most buildings wait until they are gone.
Mr. Psychic's house (southeast): TM29 Psychic, free.
Copycat's house 2F: give her a Poké Doll (Celadon 4F) and she teaches Mimic once.
Fighting Dojo: four Black Belts, then Karate Master Koichi.
After the Dojo, pick ONE: Hitmonlee (Attack/Speed, kicks) or Hitmonchan (elemental punches, which are special in Gen 3 and run off its weak Sp. Atk). Hitmonlee is the stronger pick.

encounter.savePoint: Save before talking to Koichi after beating him

steps.text: Silph Co.: 11 floors. Teleporter pads link floors; locked doors need the Card Key from 5F. Rocket Grunts and Scientists everywhere, lots of items.
5F: pick up the Card Key (item ball) — it opens every locked door in the building.

7F: Rival battle 6 at the stairs. Pidgeot Lv.37, Gyarados/Growlithe/Exeggcute Lv.35-38, Alakazam Lv.35, starter Lv.40. Alakazam is fast and frail: hit it with a Bug/Ghost move or a strong physical attack.
7F: the Silph employee in the locked room gives a Lapras Lv.25 (Water/Ice, learns Surf, Ice Beam, Thunderbolt).

encounter.savePoint: Save before talking to the employee

steps.text: The 3F teleporter behind the Card Key door leads to 7F northwest, whose teleporter reaches 11F. Beat the two Grunts guarding the president's office.
Giovanni again (11F). Nidorino Lv.37, Kangaskhan Lv.35, Rhyhorn Lv.37, Nidoqueen Lv.41. Water, Ice, Grass and Psychic moves; Lapras is ideal.
The President gives you the Master Ball. Save it for Mewtwo (or a legendary bird).

Sabrina: Kadabra Lv.38, Mr. Mime Lv.37, Venomoth Lv.38, Alakazam Lv.43 (Psychic, Calm Mind). Psychic types have low Defense: strong physical attackers (Snorlax Body Slam, Tauros, Rhydon) or Bug moves (Scyther, Pinsir). Bite is special in Gen 3, so Gyarados's Bite works too. Avoid Fighting and Poison types. Gym teleporters: from the entrance, take top-right, then bottom-left, then top-right again to reach Sabrina.
Gym Leader Sabrina. Marsh Badge (obedience to Lv.70) and TM04 Calm Mind.
